name: find_leads
description: Lead finder: natural-language lead requests ('find US LLC formation agencies in Texas', 'e-commerce founders in UAE who need US company setup') with optional filters (industry, location, company size, max results). Pipeline: resolved request -> search queries -> public pages (ScrapeGraphAI when installed, built-in search+fetch extraction otherwise) -> structured fields {name, company, role, website, public email/phone, location, source_url, relevance, notes} -> dedupe -> fact-check verify -> rank -> table + CSV/XLSX export. Public business data only, robots.txt respected, every lead keeps its source URL.
route: find leads, find agencies or founders or companies matching a description, build a prospect list, find more like these
